summary: Sportradar Group AG filed a Form 6-K announcing three routine updates: Sameer Deen's appointment as COO effective May 18, 2026; Q1 2026 financial results; and an enhanced open market repurchase agreement with Morgan Stanley to repurchase up to $250 million of Class A shares by August 28, 2026, under a previously authorized $1 billion buyback plan. None of these constitute a special situation: the management change is a planned appointment, not a forced/abrupt departure; the results are routine; the repurchase is an ordinary capital return program. Filing is a standard foreign private issuer update. What to watch is earnings and buyback progress. No deal terms.
